title: Auditor Sênior
description:
Main responsibilities of the position:


Job Summary:


The Senior Auditor within Global Internal Audit (GIA) executes independent, objective assurance and advisory activities to assess the effectiveness of the Bank’s governance, risk management, and internal control processes. This hands‑on role supports audit engagements across all phases, including planning, risk assessment, fieldwork, reporting, and issue validation, and may lead assigned audit components or workstreams. The Senior Auditor is responsible for delivering assigned audit activities and documentation, identifying risks and control gaps, developing clear and actionable recommendations, and supporting the Audit In‑Charge (AIC) and Audit Manager with engagement execution, coordination, and stakeholder communication.


Major Responsibilities:


  • Execute risk‑based internal audit engagements in accordance with the IIA’s International Professional Practices Framework (IPPF), GIA Methodology, and applicable banking regulatory expectations.
  • Assess the design and operating effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal control processes across banking products, operations, and support functions.
  • Apply professional skepticism and personal accountability to identify control weaknesses, assess root causes, and evaluate the impact on risk and risk management practices.
  • Generate insightful, well‑articulated audit observations that clearly convey significance, risk impact, and management implications, and report audit findings and issues to Audit Management.
  • Prepare and maintain high‑quality, stand‑alone audit documentation and workpapers that fully support audit conclusions and enable independent re‑performance.
  • Support the Audit In‑Charge (AIC) and Audit Manager with engagement execution, issue validation, and effective communication with management and key stakeholders.
  • Operate with an innovative and flexible mindset by continuously identifying opportunities to enhance audit consistency, efficiency, quality, and overall value.
  • Maintain effective working relationships with business, risk, and compliance partners while preserving independence and objectivity.


Desired experience for the role:


  • 4+ years of progressive experience in internal audit, external audit, risk management, or compliance, preferably within banking or financial services.
  • Experience executing risk‑based internal audit engagements end‑to‑end, including planning, fieldwork, reporting, and issue validation.
  • Hands‑on experience evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls across banking products, operations, and support functions.
  • Experience applying IIA IPPF standards and working within environments subject to banking regulatory oversight.
  • Experience producing stand‑alone audit documentation and workpapers that support conclusions and enable independent re‑performance.
  • Experience developing and reporting clear, risk‑focused audit observations that articulate significance, root cause, and impact on risk and risk management practices.


Specific knowledge, skills, and certifications required for the role:


  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills, required due to audit methodology, documentation, and regular interaction with global and local stakeholders conducted in English.
  • CIA preferred;
    CISA, CRMA, CRC, CPA-10, CPA-20 or equivalent professional certification is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of internal audit principles, risk‑based auditing, and internal control frameworks within a banking environment.
  • Ability to apply professional skepticism, sound judgment, and personal accountability when evaluating risks and controls.
  • Capability to develop clear, risk‑focused audit observations and communicate issues effectively to Audit Management and stakeholders.
  • Ability to prepare high‑quality, stand‑alone audit documentation that supports conclusions and enables independent re‑performance.
  • 'Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
  • Advanced degree (e.G., MBA or Master’s in Accounting/Finance) is a plus.

  • Escolaridade: Ensino Médio completo.

LumiMeds is a fast-growing U.S.-based telehealth startup focused on weight management and long-term metabolic health. We are building the next generation of e-commerce and clinical infrastructure from the ground up.

As an early-stage company, we move quickly, operate with limited layers, and expect high ownership from every team member. There is no bureaucracy here — decisions happen fast, priorities evolve, and builders thrive.

We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values clarity, accountability, and people who take initiative rather than wait for direction.


Location: Remote / Hybrid - we accept candidates located across LATAM, South America, Europe

Seniority: Mid-Level / Senior (Individual Contributor)


Role Overview

LumiMeds is a high-growth telehealth platform building the next generation of virtual telehealth infrastructure. We are looking for an AI-First Frontend Engineer who builds beautiful, performant, and clinically reliable interfaces —and uses AI to do it at a pace that consistently surprises people.


You are not a designer who codes, nor a utility developer who ships components on request. You are an engineer who can translate a Figma frame into a pixel-perfect, highly performant Next.Js experience, architect the state model behind it, and use AI tooling to compress a week of work into a day. You know how to direct Claude agent teams to handle parallelizable work — generating component variants, writing test suites, auditing accessibility — so you can stay focused on the decisions that require human judgment. You will balance 90% hands-on codingwith 10% mentorship, and you are expected to set the bar for frontend quality and velocity on the team.


Core Technical Domains

You will own the user-facing layer across our consumer and clinical platforms:

  • Performant Marketing & E-commerce: Engineering lightning-fast, SEO-optimized storefronts and landing pages. You treat Core Web Vitals as a first-class deliverable.
  • Clinical Web Application (EMR & Provider Portal): Building the “Clinical OS” — complex, state-heavy interfaces where data integrity and reliability are non-negotiable.
  • AI-Powered UI Features: Implementing streaming LLM responses, real-time clinical summaries, and conversational interfaces embedded into patient and provider flows.
  • Virtual Care Interfaces: Implementing WebRTC video components, real-time secure messaging, and low-latency async consultation flows.
  • Design System & Motion: Maintaining a component library using Framer Motion to produce purposeful animations that make the platform feel premium and intuitive.


Key Responsibilities

  • AI-Augmented Frontend Development: Use Cursor, Copilot, and LLMs as first-class tools to generate components, write tests, and iterate on UI logic at high velocity. Prompt quality is part of the craft.
  • Claude Agent Team Orchestration: Coordinate Claude agent teams via the Claude Agent SDK to execute parallelizable frontend work — generating component variants, writing test suites, auditing accessibility, and producing design-to-code translations at scale. You know how to structure agent prompts, verify outputs, and integrate agent-generated code into the production codebase reliably.
  • Aesthetic Engineering: Translate high-fidelity Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive experiences that hold visual integrity across all device sizes and breakpoints.
  • Performance Ownership: Own Core Web Vitals — optimize LCP, INP, and bundle size. Understand hydration, streaming SSR, and caching strategies at a deep level.
  • AI UI Integration: Build and maintain frontend interfaces that consume LLM outputs — streaming text, structured responses, tool-call results — in ways that feel fluid and reliable to end users.
  • State Architecture: Design resilient client-side state capable of handling real-time clinical data, optimistic updates, and complex form flows across the patient journey.
  • Compliance & Security: Ensure all interfaces meet HIPAA/SOC2 standards, with a focus on secure data handling, audit trails, and PII protection.


Required Hard Skills & Tech Stack

  • Next.Js Mastery: Expert-level knowledge of the App Router, Server Components (RSC), and sophisticated caching/streaming strategies.
  • The “Beautiful Web” Stack: Expert proficiency in Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion for fluid, high-end interfaces.
  • Performance Optimization: Proven track record optimizing bundle sizes, hydration cycles, and Lighthouse scores.
  • State Management: Expertise in TanStack Query (server state) and Zustand (client state).
  • LLM UI Patterns: Experience building streaming response UIs, chat interfaces, or AI-assisted input flows using OpenAI or Anthropic APIs.
  • Claude Agent Teams: Hands-on experience building and directing Claude agent teams using the Claude Agent SDK — from bulk component generation to automated visual regression and test coverage. You can design an agent pipeline, define subagent roles, and validate the output before it lands in production.
  • AI Dev Tooling: Daily active use of Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent. Strong opinions on how to use AI for component generation, refactoring, and test writing.
  • Browser Fundamentals: Deep understanding of the DOM, rendering pipeline, and HIPAA-compliant data handling in the browser.


Candidate Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional frontend engineering experience.
  • AI-Native Workflow: You can demonstrate concretely how AI has accelerated your frontend output. Examples or portfolio required.
  • The Dual-Threat Portfolio: Proven experience building both visually polished, high-traffic marketing sites and complex, data-driven SaaS applications.
  • Uncompromising Eye for Detail: You notice when spacing is off by 2px and care enough to fix it. Typography, micro-interactions, and motion are part of your craft.
  • High Agency: Ability to self-direct, operate in ambiguity, and make high-leverage frontend decisions without constant supervision.
  • Communication: Professional proficiency in English for technical documentation and cross-functional collaboration.


Why Join LumiMeds?

  • AI as Infrastructure: We don’t bolt AI on — it’s embedded in how we build. You’ll be encouraged and expected to use every tool available to ship faster and better.
  • Design-Forward Culture: We believe healthcare should be beautiful. You’ll have the technical freedom to build a premium brand experience without compromise.
  • Direct Impact: Fast, intuitive, and beautiful interfaces directly affect patient outcomes and provider efficiency.

title: Assistente De Faturamento E Suporte Comercial
description:
Assistente de Faturamento e Suporte Comercial


Sobre nós


Somos uma das fabricantes de embalagens metálicas de aço mais versáteis do país. Desde 1960, temos orgulho de transformar ideias em soluções criativas, sustentáveis e inovadoras.

Acreditamos que o sucesso é construído por pessoas comprometidas, colaborativas e motivadas a evoluir continuamente. Valorizamos o aprendizado constante, a troca de experiências e o crescimento coletivo.

Se você gosta de desafios, trabalha bem em equipe e quer contribuir para um ambiente mais seguro, produtivo e inovador, você vai se identificar com a gente!


Como será o seu dia a dia


Nesta posição, você terá um papel-chave de interface. Sua missão será acompanhar o fluxo entre a venda, a produção e o faturamento, assegurando a conformidade tributária e a consistência das informações para as áreas Financeira, Fiscal e Comercial da empresa.

Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar como Assistente Fiscal, com foco em faturamento e atuação próxima à área comercial. Você fará parte de uma rotina dinâmica em uma indústria de médio porte, com contato direto com diferentes regimes tributários (Lucro Real, Presumido e Simples).

Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para quem deseja consolidar sua carreira na área fiscal/tributária dentro de um ambiente fabril estruturado e em constante evolução.


Como Assistente Faturamento e Suporte Comercial seus desafios serão:

  • Emitir, classificar e conferir notas fiscais (vendas, transferências, devoluções e remessas), garantindo a correta aplicação de CFOPs e natureza de operação;


  • Realizar o cálculo e a conferência de impostos e retenções, considerando os regimes de Lucro Real, Presumido e Simples Nacional;
  • Controlar pedidos de venda faturados via ERP/CRM, assegurando a consistência das informações e apoiando a equipe comercial;
  • Atuar em conjunto com o PCP no acompanhamento do ciclo de produção, contribuindo para o cumprimento dos prazos de faturamento;
  • Apoiar em consultas à legislação tributária (municipal, estadual e federal) e na organização de documentos para fiscalizações e auditorias;
  • Organizar e manter os documentos fiscais, contábeis e comerciais, garantindo fácil acesso e controle das informações.


Sobre o nosso processo seletivo:

  • Aplicação na vaga.
  • Entrevistas com o RH e Gestor.
  • Proposta de trabalho.


Requisitos:

  • Formação: Ensino Médio completo (Desejável Superior em andamento em Ciências Contábeis, Administração ou correlatas);
  • Experiência Técnica: Vivência sólida em faturamento industrial, com foco em emissão, classificação e conferência de notas fiscais;
  • Conhecimento Fiscal: Noções de legislação tributária e cálculo de impostos/retenções (ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, ISS), preferencialmente em regimes de Lucro Real e Presumido;
  • Ferramentas: Experiência com sistemas ERP (uso de CRM será um diferencial) e domínio de Excel nível intermediário;
  • Perfil: Organização impecável e atenção aos detalhes (perfil voltado para conformidade e precisão de dados);
  • Atitude: Proatividade para transitar entre as áreas de PCP e Comercial, garantindo o fluxo do pedido até o faturamento.


Benefícios:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado (CLT).
  • Auxílio-transporte.
  • Auxílio-alimentação.
  • Café da manhã.
  • Auxílio estudo (Cursos relacionados à área).
  • Convênio médico opcional após 90 dias.
  • Convênio odontológico após 90 dias.


Tipo de emprego:

  • Regime: Tempo integral e Presencial.
  • Horário: Segunda a quinta, das 7h30 às 17h30;
    sexta das 8h às 17h

title: Senior Specialist — Biopharmaceutical Characterization (Hr Lc-Ms Qtof/Orbitrap)

We are currently expanding our scientific capabilities and seeking a Senior Specialist with strong experience in high-resolution LC-MS and biopharmaceutical characterization , capable of leading technically complex analytical studies and contributing to the continuous growth of our advanced bioanalytical platform.

  • Serve as a technical reference in high-resolution LC-MS (QToF and/or Orbitrap) applications
  • Lead advanced biopharmaceutical structural characterization studies
  • Develop and validate analytical methods for proteins, peptides, and biosimilars
  • Perform advanced MS and MS/MS data interpretation
  • Support and lead biosimilar comparability studies
  • Conduct technical discussions with internal teams and clients
  • Support troubleshooting and complex analytical investigations
  • Contribute to knowledge transfer and technical development of team members

  • Amino acid sequencing
  • Peptide Mapping
  • Intact Mass Analysis
  • Identification of structural variants
  • Degradation product characterization
  • Post-translational modifications (PTMs) analysis


Higher-Order Structure Characterization

  • Secondary structure analysis (e.G., Circular Dichroism — CD )
  • Protein conformational analysis
  • Structural stability assessment
  • Tertiary structure-related characterization techniques




Biopharmaceutical Characterization:


  • Biosimilar comparability studies
  • Molecular heterogeneity assessment
  • Aggregates and fragments analysis
  • Charge variant profiling
  • Stability and forced degradation studies


Required Qualifications:


  • Proven experience in high-resolution LC-MS , including:
  • QToF
  • Orbitrap
  • Strong experience in biopharmaceutical characterization , including:
  • Peptide Mapping
  • Amino acid sequencing
  • Intact Mass Analysis
  • MS/MS interpretation


  • Experience in:


  • Analytical method development and validation
  • Structural elucidation
  • Complex data interpretation
  • Knowledge of regulatory expectations related to biopharmaceuticals:
  • ANVISA

  • ICH guidelines




  • Preferred Qualifications:


Structural Characterization

  • Circular Dichroism (CD)
  • FTIR
  • DSC (Differential Scanning Calorimetry)

  • Intrinsic Fluorescence

Advanced Biopharmaceutical Analysis

  • Multi-Attribute Methods (MAM)
  • Biosimilar analytical comparability
  • Monoclonal antibody characterization
  • Proteomics workflows

  • Strong scientific thinking

title: Devops Engineer
description:

Buscamos um(a) DevOps Sênior para atuar na liderança técnica da sustentação, evolução e arquitetura de ambientes de infraestrutura complexos, com forte atuação em Cloud, automação, observabilidade, resiliência e governança de ambientes críticos. Este profissional será referência técnica da equipe, apoiando desenvolvimento, testes e operações, além de participar ativamente das decisões arquiteturais, definição de padrões, automação de infraestrutura e melhoria contínua dos ambientes e processos.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES


O que te espera no dia a dia:


- Liderar a sustentação e evolução de ambientes complexos, garantindo alta disponibilidade, performance e estabilidade de servidores, aplicações e serviços de infraestrutura críticos.

- Projetar, validar e evoluir arquiteturas escaláveis e resilientes, alinhadas a práticas Cloud Native e arquitetura distribuída.

- Atuar como referência técnica (Nível 3) no suporte às equipes de desenvolvimento e testes, liderando troubleshooting avançado e análise de causa raiz de incidentes críticos.

- Definir e implementar estratégias de observabilidade, monitoramento proativo, métricas de capacidade, SLI/SLO e planos de Disaster Recovery.

- Padronizar e documentar arquiteturas, processos de infraestrutura, pipelines e fluxos de automação, garantindo disseminação de conhecimento e governança técnica.

- Impulsionar inovação tecnológica, avaliando e propondo novas ferramentas, arquiteturas e metodologias (IaC, CI/CD, DevSecOps, FinOps, Observability).

- Garantir governança, segurança e conformidade dos ambientes, incluindo patching, hardening, gestão de acessos, auditoria e políticas de continuidade de negócio.

- Atuar como mentor técnico do time, apoiando a evolução técnica dos profissionais e a adoção de boas práticas de engenharia de infraestrutura e DevOps.

- Apoiar a otimização de custos em Cloud através de práticas FinOps, capacity planning e revisão de arquiteturas.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


- Domínio de sistemas operacionais Linux, Unix e/ou BSD, com ênfase em distribuições Linux baseadas em RedHat.

- Experiência em arquitetura e governança de ambientes Cloud, preferencialmente AWS.

- Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Zabbix, CloudWatch, NewRelic, Grafana e Prometheus.

- Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código utilizando Ansible e Terraform.

- Administração de servidores Web e de aplicação como Nginx, Apache, Tomcat, PM2 e IIS.

- Experiência com pipelines de Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua (Jenkins, GitHub Actions ou similares).

- Domínio de orquestração de containers e ambientes distribuídos utilizando Docker, ECS e Kubernetes.

- Experiência em ambientes Web, plataformas de alta volumetria ou ambientes de missão crítica.

- Experiência com práticas de FinOps e otimização de custos em Cloud.

- Administração de Windows Server, Active Directory e GPOs.

- Conhecimentos de redes e infraestrutura (Firewall, Load Balancer, Roteadores, Storage).

- Administração de bancos de dados como MySQL, SQL Server, ElasticSearch e MongoDB.

- Experiência com automação e scripting utilizando Python, Shell Script e PowerShell.


Para fazer parte do nosso time, é essencial:


- Ensino Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

- Inglês técnico avançado.

- Capacidade analítica para troubleshooting de alta complexidade em ambientes críticos.

- Boa comunicação oral e escrita, com capacidade de negociação e influência técnica.

- Bom relacionamento interpessoal e trabalho em equipe.

- Proatividade e senso de dono sobre os ambientes e plataformas.

- Boa capacidade de planejamento e visão arquitetural.

- Visão analítica e pensamento crítico.

- Perfil de liderança técnica e mentoria.

- Resiliência e capacidade de atuação sob pressão em incidentes críticos.


Diferenciais:


- Certificações Linux (LPI ou RedHat), Cloud (AWS) ou DevOps.

- Espanhol.

- Experiência com práticas e ferramentas DevSecOps e conformidade (LGPD).

title: Analista De Suprimentos Pleno (Comprador De Serviços Florestais)
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú


O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

description:

In this role, you’ll translate complex product requirements into clear user flows, wireframes, and prototypes that enhance usability and user satisfaction. You’ll play a key role in building and evolving our design system, ensuring consistency across products, and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to bring designs to life. If you’re passionate about shaping user-centric interfaces and scaling design impact in a fast-moving environment, we’d love to meet you.


What You Will Do

  • Develop intuitive user flows and wireframes for complex products to ensure clear and user-friendly navigation.
  • Build interactive prototypes using Figma (or other design tools) to effectively communicate ideas and facilitate usability testing.
  • Support, maintain, and evolve the company’s design system and component libraries to ensure consistency and scalability.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, developers, marketers, and other teams to ensure high-quality and coherent design implementation.
  • Contribute to shaping and scaling the brand’s visual identity as the company grows.


What You Will Need To Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Computer Science, or a related field
  • At least 2 years of experience in UI/UX design, ideally working on digital products or platforms
  • Proficiency in Figma (or similar tools like Sketch or Adobe XD) for wireframing and prototyping
  • Strong understanding of user-centered design principles and usability best practices
  • Experience or familiarity with data-driven design, including interpreting analytics to inform user flows
  • A portfolio that demonstrates real-world design solutions, your process, and collaborative work across teams
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English (C1 level or higher)
  • Strong foundation in product design and user experience principles, with a keen eye for usability and aesthetics
  • Proficiency in user interface design, supported by hands-on experience and a solid visual design sensibility
  • A portfolio that highlights your design capabilities, thought process, and contributions to real-world projects


Why Join Us?

  • If you are eager to take your career to the next level in the payment industry, this is the opportunity for you. We offer:
  • Competitive compensation depending on experience and skills
  • Career advancement opportunities across a global network
  • A dynamic, international team environment
  • Exposure to the fintech and gaming industries
  • Office-based role in Curitiba Office.


This role is the ideal opportunity for someone looking for new challenges that would allow them to make a noticeable, positive impact in the company while learning and adapting to our fast-paced scale-up environment.


As part of our growing team in Curitiba, you will have a lot of opportunities to develop your career further with us. With future expansion plans, now is a great time to join us on our journey to change the way we pay.


Notes: Kindly submit the English Version of your CV and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
A Monest é uma fintech especializada em recuperação de crédito que está revolucionando o mercado de cobranças no Brasil. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e inteligência artificial, somos pioneiros no mercado brasileiro e a primeira empresa do país a integrar um agente virtual a um LLM, tornando o processo 100% autônomo, escalável e humanizado.


O desafio


Você vai reforçar o time de design da Monest em um momento de evolução da plataforma. Isso significa ajudar a definir o padrão visual do produto, construir a base de componentes que o time vai usar daqui pra frente e ter ownership sobre a experiência de módulos inteiros, da pesquisa ao acompanhamento em produção.


O que você vai fazer


- Liderar o UI Facelift da plataforma, da auditoria visual e benchmark até a entrega de telas redesenhadas, biblioteca de componentes e guia de estilo.

- Construir e manter a biblioteca de componentes no Figma (tokens, variantes, estados) que permita ao time escalar com consistência.

- Conduzir pesquisa com usuários reais antes de propor soluções: entrevistas, análise de comportamento, testes de usabilidade.

- Trabalhar no trio PM-Design-Dev desde a descoberta, não como executor de briefings.

- Explorar alternativas antes de convergir, documentar decisões e entregar especificações completas para dev (estados, edge cases, erros, responsividade).

- Testar com usuários, acompanhar métricas pós-lançamento e iterar com base em evidência.


Requisitos


- 5+ anos como Product Designer em produtos B2B.

- Experiência com evolução visual de produto em escala: modernizar e sistematizar.

- Vivência real com bibliotecas de componentes: criação ou manutenção.

- Processo de design end-to-end: pesquisa → ideação → prototipação → teste → acompanhamento.

- Especificação detalhada para dev.

- Proficiência em Figma.


Diferenciais


- Experiência em fintechs ou startups B2B SaaS.

- Vivência com produtos de plataforma (dashboards, tabelas, fluxos operacionais).

- Familiaridade com frontend (entender código, não necessariamente escrever).

- Inglês intermediário+.

title: Hse Coordinator (Goiânia / Go)
description:
MISSION

Lead the Safety department, ensuring the implementation of Coty’s global strategy at the site and full compliance with applicable Brazilian legal requirements. Act as an early and active partner in all matters that impact employee safety and the company’s reputation, guaranteeing adherence to the site’s Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) Policy and Coty’s global HSE expectations.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure full understanding and compliance with the Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) Policy;
  • Comply with allcompany procedures and instructions, not only those related to occupational safety;
  • Advise local leaders on the human and financial resources needed to efficiently implement HSE policies, procedures, and programs;
  • Ensure the company is aware of upcoming legislation and its potential impact, while maintaining compliance with current laws and regulations;
  • Provide technical expertise to the site regarding HSE policies, procedures, and programs.
  • Develop and monitor objectives, targets, policies, procedures, and programs to meet legal requirements and continuously improve safety, environmental performance, and reporting systems;
  • Create and manage the site’s HSE Action Plan, ensuring proper follow-up and completion of all initiatives;
  • Participate in management meetings, as appropriate, to provide updates on HSE performance and related matters;
  • Ensure adequateand effective incident-reporting systems across all departments, including communication, escalation, notification, investigation, and corrective actions to prevent recurrence;
  • Collect and provide monthly accident and incident statistics, including lost-time cases and trend analyses, for senior management review;
  • Ensure the sitemaintains a fully compliant Safety Station according to Coty global standards, with proper training and resources to sustain the process;
  • Guarantee that sufficient and appropriate risk assessments are performed and that control measures proportional to risk levels are implemented throughout the site;
  • Prepare the annual HSE audit schedule and conduct audits to evaluate site performance against Coty’s Six Key HSE Management Elements;
  • Support the resolution of HSE issues as they arise;
  • Ensure all relevant health and safety records are maintained and readily available for inspections when required;
  • Interact with local HSE authorities—such as police, fire department, and health & safety inspectors—during visits/inspections and ensure implementation of their recommendations;
  • Ensure the Emergency Response Team is fully trained, operational, and prepared to act;
  • Ensure the Internal Accident and Harassment Prevention Committee (CIPA) operates autonomously and fulfills its responsibilities;
  • Ensure compliance with all municipal, state, and federal HSE regulations, as well as Coty’s corporate standards;
  • Ensure all third-party service providers comply with applicable health and safety legislation;
  • Schedule and participate in site audits and self-assessments;
  • Train and support key system owners in their respective HSE responsibilities.


REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related fields;
  • Postgraduate degree in Occupational Safety Engineering;
  • Advanced English proficiency (mandatory);
  • Extensive experience (minimum 5 years) managing high-risk operations, particularly in Occupational Safety roles;
  • Solid experience in people management;
  • Active participation in global HSE networks is a plus;
  • Strong knowledge of risk management, prevention, and control measures;
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook);
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong ability to document processes clearly;
  • Strong presentation skills and ability to communicate effectively across different organizational levels.


BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES (SOFT SKILLS)

  • Strong sense of ownership;
    actively present on theshop floor, identifying opportunities for improvement and team development;
  • Intellectual curiosity;
  • Agility, creativity, and innovation;
  • Entrepreneurialand hands-on mindset, with fast execution;
  • Ability to go above and beyond, delivering high-impact results;
  • Capacity to build, develop, and engage teams quickly and effectively;
  • Strong teamworkand collaboration spirit.

title: Information Technology Specialist
description:
Overview

We are looking for a dedicated and proactive On-Site IT Support Engineer to provide hands-on support for our local infrastructure, users, and critical systems. This role ensures smooth IT operations, continuity of services, and timely resolution of incidents during the designated support period. The engineer will serve as the primary point of contact for IT-related issues at the site, while also performing preventive maintenance and ensuring system stability.


Key Responsibilities

Scope of Work / Activities to be Covered

  • Provide on-site support for resolving technical incidents related to infrastructure, systems, and end-user devices.
  • Perform monitoring of IT equipment and infrastructure maintenance, ensuring uptime and reliability.
  • Offer desktop/user support for local staff, including troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues.
  • Conduct preventive maintenance activities such as security checks, system health checks, and patch updates.
  • Monitor and coordinate critical service requests with remote teams and vendors as needed.
  • Assist in escalating complex incidents to higher-level support teams while ensuring proper follow-through.
  • Expected Results
  • Operational Continuity Maintenance: Ensure that business processes and local operations remain unaffected during the support period.
  • Quality of Service: Deliver efficient, timely, and professional IT support with effective problem-solving skills.
  • Reliable Technical Support: Minimize downtime and interruptions across IT systems and infrastructure.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Prepare and submit clear incident logs, resolution details, and preventive maintenance reports for transparency and accountability.


Qualifications & Skills

  • Should be able to communicate in English
  • Proven experience in IT support, helpdesk, or desktop engineering roles.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows/Mac operating systems, networking basics, hardware, and peripherals.
  • Familiarity with ITSM ticketing systems and incident management processes.
  • Ability to conduct preventive maintenance and security checks.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to interact with end-users at all levels.
  • Detail-oriented with strong documentation and reporting skills.
  • Professional certifications (CompTIA A+, Network+, ITIL, or Microsoft/CCNA) are a plus.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

title: Director Talent Acquisition
description:
The Talent Acquisition Director for Brazil is responsible for defining and executing a comprehensive national recruitment strategy aligned with business growth, client demand, and local labor market dynamics. This role ensures the attraction, selection, and retention of high-quality talent across multiple sites and business lines within Brazil, while driving innovation, operational excellence, and diversity in hiring practices.


Role Responsibilities


1. Strategic Leadership & Planning

  • Define and execute the Brazil Talent Acquisition strategy aligned with company objectives, national headcount plans, and client demand forecasts.
  • Partner with Brazil Operations, HR, Finance, and Workforce Management leaders to anticipate talent needs and capacity requirements.
  • Translate national business goals into actionable recruitment plans and measurable KPIs.
  • Develop workforce planning insights to proactively address hiring volume fluctuations, seasonal peaks, and new business ramp-ups within Brazil.
  • Leverage Brazilian labor market intelligence to inform location strategy, compensation competitiveness, and sourcing channels.


2. National Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop Talent Acquisition Managers and recruitment teams across multiple Brazilian sites to ensure consistent execution, capability building, and engagement.
  • Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure alignment with global TA frameworks, tools, and employer branding standards while adapting them to Brazil’s cultural and market realities.
  • Drive recruiter capability development in high-volume BPO hiring and specialized talent segments.


3. Operational Excellence

  • Oversee end-to-end recruitment operations across all Brazil delivery centers and remote hiring markets, ensuring timely, quality, and cost-effective hiring.
  • Monitor and report Brazil-specific TA metrics such as time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, candidate quality, early attrition (training/nesting), and hiring manager satisfaction.
  • Partner with Training & Quality teams to ensure hiring quality translates into strong operational performance and first-90-day retention.
  • Identify process bottlenecks and implement automation, analytics, and digital recruitment tools to optimize hiring outcomes nationwide.


4. Stakeholder & Client Management

  • Act as the primary Talent Acquisition point of contact for Brazil business leaders, client representatives, and external partners.
  • Collaborate with Client Services and Operations to support new business transitions, site expansions, and staffing proposals within Brazil.
  • Participate in client presentations, RFP responses, and site visits, representing Brazil TA capabilities, performance, and innovation.
  • Build and sustain strong partnerships with Brazilian universities, job boards, government labor programs, and community organizations to ensure robust national talent pipelines.


5. Data-Driven Decision Making

  • Utilize recruitment analytics and Brazilian labor market intelligence to drive strategic decisions and recommend data-backed solutions.
  • Develop and maintain national dashboards to ensure visibility of hiring performance and enable agile workforce decisions.
  • Present regular updates to Brazil executive leadership on hiring trends, risks, productivity, and achievements.


6. Employer Branding & Candidate Experience

  • Lead employer branding initiatives within Brazil to position the company as an employer of choice in the Brazilian BPO sector.
  • Ensure a consistent, inclusive, and culturally relevant candidate experience aligned with company values and employer brand.
  • Promote Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) through targeted outreach and recruitment strategies aligned with Brazil’s diversity landscape.


7. Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure all recruitment activities comply with Brazilian labor legislation, data protection laws (including LGPD), and ethical hiring standards.
  • Maintain audit readiness and process documentation aligned with internal controls and external compliance requirements (e.G., COPC, ISO, or client-specific standards).


8. Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive adoption of AI, automation, and digital recruitment marketing to modernize hiring practices across Brazil.
  • Benchmark national practices against Brazilian BPO and talent acquisition market leaders to introduce best-in-class models.
  • Integrate predictive analytics and skill-based hiring approaches to anticipate Brazil’s future workforce needs.



Requirements


  • 10+ years of Talent Acquisition experience, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
  • Fluent in English and advanced Spanish proficiency (Spanish is not a must).
  • Proven experience leading high-volume, multi-site recruitment operations in Brazil (BPO or multinational environment).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field (MBA or postgraduate preferred).
  • Strong knowledge of the Brazilian labor market, labor legislation, and LGPD.
  • Demonstrated expertise in workforce planning, large-scale ramp-ups, and recruitment analytics (KPIs, dashboards, cost control).
  • Experience implementing and optimizing ATS, CRM, and digital/AI-driven sourcing tools. (Workday)
  • Strong stakeholder management and client-facing skills.

title: Account Executive
description:
Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America.

We originate more than R$700M per year in B2B credit to Brazilian SMEs through CrediPay , our embedded finance platform. We operate in a segment where traditional financial infrastructure is limited, building proprietary credit intelligence and risk frameworks that do not yet exist in this market.

By combining structured capital markets solutions with real-time credit decisioning, we enable marketplaces and suppliers to offer seamless payment terms to their buyers, while we manage risk, pricing, and capital efficiency behind the scenes.

We are not a traditional lender. We are building the risk engine that powers scalable B2B commerce in Brazil.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

The Account Executive will be responsible for driving revenue growth through the prospecting, qualification, and closing of new business opportunities. Acting as the primary point of contact for potential clients, you will manage the full sales cycle, from first outreach to contract signature, positioning Credix’s financial solutions as the ideal fit for each client’s business objectives.


Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years of proven experience as Account Executive or in a similar sales role.
  • Track record of meeting and exceeding sales quotas.
  • Experience selling Financial Solutions and/or B2B Services, ideally into Industry, Wholesale & Distribution verticals.
  • Proficiency in CRM systems and pipeline management tools.
  • Fluent English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong negotiation and closing techniques.
  • Ability to build trusted professional relationships at all organizational levels.
  • Results-driven and self-motivated, comfortable working autonomously and cross-functionally.
  • Consultative approach — positions solutions based on client needs, not product features.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration in a fast-paced fintech environment.
  • Willingness to travel across São Paulo and Brazil as needed for in-person client meetings.


Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of existing pipeline and make contact with key stakeholders from day one.
  • Build a robust and accurate pipeline of qualified opportunities with clear segmentation by ICP.
  • Close deals and consistently meet and exceed quarterly sales quotas and KPIs defined by the Revenue lead.
  • Maintain CRM hygiene with up-to-date activity logs, pipeline stages, and account intelligence after every interaction.
  • Conduct effective product demos and proposals for decision-makers and key stakeholders, achieving a demo-to-proposal conversion rate above benchmark.
  • Collaborate with Marketing and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth client transitions and high early retention.


What we offer

We believe that collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow together. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo or Antwerp, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration. But that’s just the beginning — here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies.
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate.
  • Bi-annual off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Quem somos nós

Na Amaris Consulting , acreditamos que a tecnologia deve servir às pessoas — e não o contrário. Somos uma consultoria independente de tecnologia e gestão que apoia empresas em seus projetos de transformação em todo o mundo.

Presente em mais de 60 países e reunindo mais de 7.000 pessoas de 110 nacionalidades diferentes, atuamos em diversos setores — desde tecnologia da informação, engenharia, ciências da vida, até energia e telecomunicações.

  • Realizar um mapeamento de clientes/ofertas, tecnologias e competências do mercado com o apoio de outros departamentos internos do Grupo.

Gestão de Equipe

  • Contribuir na elaboração e análise de planos de negócios.

  • Propor e implementar novos processos e iniciativas de melhoria.


Recursos Humanos

  • Participar do recrutamento e da gestão da equipe de consultores (prospecção, entrevistas, relatórios, assinatura de contratos etc.).
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento de carreira da equipe (atribuição de funções, avaliações, envolvimento de talentos-chave etc.).
  • Antecipar e gerenciar situações de intercontrato, propondo soluções adequadas.


Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B, com histórico de cumprimento ou superação de metas.
  • Experiência com mercado de tecnologia.
  • Forte entendimento das técnicas de vendas e do ambiente corporativo B2B.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação.
  • Fluência em português e inglês.
  • Formação superior completa.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.


O que oferecemos

  • Um ambiente internacional com oportunidades reais de crescimento.
  • A possibilidade de atuar diretamente com clientes de diferentes países (Estados Unidos e Europa).
  • Presença em São Paulo, Curitiba e Rio de Janeiro , com oportunidades de realocação entre projetos .
  • Um modelo de negócio sólido e sustentável, com crescimento anual de 52% e mais de 400 projetos ativos no Brasil .
  • Uma cultura que valoriza o acompanhamento individual, o desenvolvimento de competências e a formação contínua .
  • Uma abordagem centrada nas pessoas — sem bodyshopping , com foco em carreira e evolução profissional .


Na Amaris Consulting, promovemos um ambiente inclusivo e valorizamos a diversidade. Todas as candidaturas são consideradas sem distinção de gênero, origem, religião, orientação sexual, deficiência ou idade.

title: Project Manager ; Artwork
description:
Role Summary

The Regional / Senior Artwork Project Manager is responsible for managing the end-to-end artwork development process (brief → final release) for packaging and labeling components within the region. This role ensures timely delivery of high-quality, compliant artwork by coordinating cross-functional teams and external vendors, while driving process improvements and maintaining operational excellence. This role combines hands-on execution with team supervision.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end artwork development process from initiation through approval and release, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality labeling components.
  • Act as the primary liaison between PMO, Regulatory Affairs, Marketing, Packaging, Quality, Supply Chain, and external vendors/agencies.
  • Validate briefs for accuracy and completeness;
    collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve discrepancies.
  • Oversee timelines, resource planning, and progress tracking for multiple concurrent labeling projects.
  • Coordinate review and approval of labeling content and artwork in internal systems, ensuring compliance with regulatory, legal, and corporate standards.
  • Drive process improvements related to artwork development, approval workflows, and digital tools.
  • Investigate Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) and implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) as needed.
  • Maintain artwork issue logs and attend escalation meetings to provide updates.
  • Identify inefficiencies and escalate to Hub Leads when required.
  • Participate in content lock meetings to ensure stakeholder alignment.
  • Manage Veraciti system-related issues and escalate appropriately.
  • Suggest and implement technology solutions for artwork and labeling processes.
  • Create, update, and maintain training documentation for systems and processes.
  • Supervise Artwork Controllers to ensure task completion and provide support during peak periods.
  • Onboard new hires on artwork management systems and end-to-end processes;
    conduct quarterly refreshers on best practices.
  • Provide guidance on escalation channels and support SMEs, Artwork Process Leads, Vendors, and Hub Leads with artwork production deployment.
  • Track and follow up on action items from cross-functional meetings.
  • Communicate project status, risks, and milestones consistently to stakeholders.
  • Attend regional project meetings (Kick-off, Overview, Alignment, Technical with Printer) and provide updates.
  • Share project insights for dashboards and analytics;
    contribute to KPI reviews and compliance initiatives.
  • Gather requirements for new regional jobs and assess resources requirements and provide job quotations when required.
  • Conduct design-to-press color management assessments and feasibility consultations.
  • Monitor and maintain regional project timelines and costs;
    anticipate and resolve roadblocks.
  • Address process and executional quality issues;
    support system and process improvements.
  • Manage ad-hoc artwork-related requests and cascade process/system communications.


Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Business, Packaging Technology, or related field;
  • 10+ years in labeling design, proofreading, coordination, regulatory, packaging, and project management within consumer health, pharmaceutical, or medical device industries.
  • Strong knowledge of global regulatory requirements for product labeling and packaging.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and cross-functional teams in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Hands-on experience with PLM and electronic artwork systems (e.G., Agile, GLAMS, Loftware, Veraciti, Veeva).
  • Expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop, Acrobat Pro).
  • Familiarity with pre-press and print processes (CMYK, Pantone, dielines, bleed, etc.).
  • Skilled in proofreading tools (e.G., TVT, GlobalVision, InformCC) and regulatory content validation.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt certification or equivalent experience in continuous improvement.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • PMP certification or formal project management training is a plus.

description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Configuração e gerenciamento de API Gateway para exposição segura de serviços. Uso de Secrets Manager para gestão de credenciais e dados sensíveis. title: Especialista Em Contabilidade
description:
We are looking for an Accounting Specialist to support the local Accounting team in delivering accurate, timely, and high-quality financial information in line with Group standards. This role plays a key part in group reporting, intercompany processes, and monthly cost closing , working closely with internal stakeholders across the organization.

This position requires a strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and the ability to interact with multiple areas in a dynamic and deadline-driven environment.


Role Purpose

The Accounting Specialist supports group reporting activities and intercompany reconciliation processes, contributing to monthly cost closing, variance analysis, and the maintenance of a strong internal control environment. The role ensures compliance with accounting policies while providing reliable financial insights to support business decisions.


Key Responsibilities

Group Reporting

  • Prepare and submit group reporting packages in line with corporate deadlines.
  • Analyze and explain balance variations versus prior periods.
  • Support group-level requests with accurate and well-documented information.


Intercompany Reconciliation

  • Manage monthly intercompany declarations and reconciliations with group entities.
  • Investigate discrepancies, ensuring timely resolution and proper documentation.
  • Continuously improve reconciliation processes to reduce closing workload and variances.


Monthly Cost Closing & Analysis

  • Perform monthly closing activities for assigned cost categories.
  • Ensure cost provisions are accurate, well-documented, and aligned with business reality.
  • Partner with Cost Control to analyze cost evolution and key drivers.


Internal Control & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with group accounting policies and internal control procedures.
  • Review and update controls as processes evolve.
  • Monitor adherence to authorization and approval policies.


Management & Interaction Scope

  • Strong interaction with Accounting, Cost Control, AP, AR, HR, and Administrative teams.
  • Interface with shared services and group entities.


Profile Requirements

  • Degree in Accounting.
  • Proven experience in accounting, auditing, cost reporting, and intercompany processes .
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Fluent English is required.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment.


Key Competencies

Analytical Thinking | Financial Acumen | Problem Solving | Communication | Results Orientation | Attention to Detail | Teamwork

This role will play an important part in bringing to life the people, communities, and work that make Ero unique. #WeAreEro #Careers #Opportunity


Ero does not charge any fees for participation in its recruitment and selection process. All applications must be submitted exclusively through our official channels.

description:

title: Executivo De Vendas
description:
Vaga: Closer (Executivo de Vendas) – Dallminas

Segmento: Soluções químicas para construção civil

Modelo: Presencial

Regime: CLT


Objetivo da contratação

A Dallminas está estruturando sua operação comercial dentro de um modelo de Máquina de Vendas e busca um profissional responsável pela etapa de fechamento das oportunidades qualificadas.


Atualmente, a empresa já possui geração de leads inbound por meio de marketing digital, redes sociais, indicações e contatos diretos. Esses leads passam por uma etapa inicial de qualificação realizada pelo MRR (Market Response Representative), que avalia perfil da empresa, necessidade técnica e potencial de compra.


No entanto, foi identificado um gargalo na etapa de conversão dessas oportunidades em vendas.

A condução das negociações ainda ocorre de forma pouco padronizada, com ausência de um processo estruturado de diagnóstico consultivo, disciplina irregular de follow-up e dependência de clientes que já chegam muito maduros para a decisão de compra.


Essa contratação tem como objetivo elevar o padrão da condução comercial, aumentar a taxa de conversão de oportunidades qualificadas e trazer maior previsibilidade para o faturamento da empresa.


Objetivo estratégico da função A

  • Aumentar a taxa de conversão de oportunidades qualificadas em vendas
  • Reduzir o tempo médio de fechamento das negociações
  • Implantar maior disciplina no acompanhamento do pipeline comercial
  • Ampliar o mix de produtos vendidos por cliente
  • Elevar o ticket médio por meio de venda consultiva
  • Contribuir para previsibilidade de receita e crescimento estruturado da empresa


Principais responsabilidades

  • Conduzir reuniões comerciais com leads qualificados pelo MRR (vídeo, telefone ou presencial)
  • Manutenção ativa de carteira já existente
  • Realizar diagnóstico consultivo para compreender necessidades técnicas e contexto dos clientes
  • Identificar oportunidades de ampliação de escopo dentro do portfólio da empresa
  • Estruturar e apresentar propostas comerciais personalizadas
  • Conduzir negociações comerciais e tratar objeções
  • Executar follow-ups estruturados para avanço das oportunidades no funil
  • Fechar contratos e atingir metas comerciais de receita
  • Gerenciar e atualizar o pipeline comercial no CRM
  • Acompanhar indicadores como taxa de conversão, ticket médio e ciclo de vendas
  • Garantir transição estruturada para o pós-venda
  • Colaborar com marketing, pré-vendas e equipe técnica


Indicadores de sucesso

Nos primeiros meses, será avaliado:

  • Conversão de oportunidades qualificadas em vendas
  • Disciplina e organização na condução do pipeline
  • Volume de interações e follow-ups realizados com leads
  • Evolução do ticket médio das vendas
  • Redução do ciclo médio de vendas
  • Receita gerada por novos contratos
  • Previsibilidade do forecast comercial
  • Aumento do LTV e melhoria da relação LTV/CAC


Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência prévia em vendas consultivas B2B (mínimo de 1 a 2 anos)
  • Experiência em fechamento de vendas e negociações comerciais
  • Vivência com clientes corporativos ou decisores técnicos
  • Experiência com metas comerciais de receita
  • Experiência com CRM e gestão de pipeline
  • Familiaridade com vendas de ticket médio intermediário
  • Familiaridade com indicadores de performance (taxas de conversão de funil, ticket médio, CAC, LTV, entre outros)


Diferencial: experiência com vendas técnicas ou atuação no setor da construção civil ou soluções industriais.


Perfil comportamental

Buscamos um(a) profissional com:

  • Foco em resultados e metas comerciais
  • Disciplina e organização
  • Capacidade de diagnóstico consultivo e escuta ativa
  • Comunicação clara e postura profissional com clientes B2B
  • Capacidade de equilibrar relacionamento e análise técnica
  • Resiliência em negociações e ciclos mais longos
  • Adaptabilidade a diferentes perfis de clientes
  • Mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo


Jornada de trabalho

  • Sexta-feira: 8h às 17h


Local de trabalho

Belo Horizonte – MG

Valoriza:

title: Pessoa Coordenadora De Qualidade
description:
Descrição da vaga


ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado;
  • Contribuir paraa evolução da jornada do consumidor no Shopping, assegurando a aderência e a aplicação consistente dos padrões estabelecidos;
  • Coordenar a execução dos treinamentos de atendimento destinados a todos os colaboradores que atuam diretamente com o público;
  • Gerir o programa de reconhecimento voltado para o time de campo, equipes terceirizadas e orgânicas;
  • Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS;
  • Gerenciar e orientar equipe orgânica, garantindo que todos cumpram suas responsabilidades de forma eficaz;
  • Assegurar a manutenção dos padrões de ambiência do mall, por meio do acompanhamento contínuo de aspectos como limpeza, iluminação, sinalização e organização dos espaços comuns;
  • Atuar na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria na percepção de qualidade do shopping, propondo ajustes e ações que elevem a experiência do cliente no mall;

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Conhecimento dos softwares AutoCAD e SketchUp;
  • Pacote Office avançado;

title: Técnico De Manutenção Especializado
description:

Estamos colocando dados para trabalhar para aumentar a eficiência, produtividade, qualidade e segurança em aplicações industriais, de fabricação, infraestrutura, setor público e mobilidade.

A divisão de Mineração da Hexagon resolve os desafios das minas subterrâneas e de superfície com tecnologias comprovadas para planejamento, operações e segurança.

A Hexagon (Nasdaq Estocolmo: HEXA B) tem aproximadamente 24.000 funcionários em 50 países e vendas líquidas de aproximadamente 5,5 bilhões de dólares. Saiba mais em hexagon.Com e siga-nos em @HexagonAB.

Esta vaga compreende trabalhar nas dependências do cliente com suporte técnico à software e manutenção em instalações de hardware de soluções tecnológicas para gerenciamento de frota em minas a céu aberto e subterrânea.

title: Sr. Data Analytics Engineer
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

We are looking for someone to join Credix as a a Senior Analytics Engineer . You will take ownership of structuring our data analytics platform and analytics use-cases. You love to tackle big problems and break them down into smaller pieces. You will build an analytics platform that features reliable, timely and understandable metrics in a slice-and-dice format to empower other teams to make better decisions.


Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain dbt models and reliable datasets that power analytics, experiments, and decision-making across the company.
  • Define and act upon standards for metrics, data modeling practices, and documentation.
  • Oversee the full analytics lifecycle, from transforming raw to delivering insights in BI platforms (e.G. Hex).
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure analytics pipelines meet high standards of quality, observability and testing.
  • Enable self-service analytics by creating semantic layers and reusable data assets that let teams create insights independently.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical data role.
  • Deep expertise with SQL and dbt, including modular modeling, documentation, and testing.
  • Proven track record of building source-of-truth data models that support product use cases.
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery), semantic layers (dbt), version control (Git), and visualization tools (Hex).
  • Experience in a (credit) FinTech is a must.
  • Manager of one: structuring, and executing upon the analytics roadmap.
  • Analytical and system-oriented mindset with a strong problem-solving ability to handle complex data challenges.
  • Proactive, clear and concise communication both in Portuguese and English, ensuring alignment with cross-functional teams.
  • Anticipate business metrics needs and structure the analytics layer to ensure scalability and reusability across the entire company.
  • High attention to detail and a perfectionist approach, especially in maintaining metrics quality and integrity.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment.
  • Genuine interest/passion for disrupting the B2B credit market in Brazil by using data.
  • Collaborative mindset, working effectively with diverse stakeholders.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.


But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

- A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies

- Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.

- Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.

- Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate

- Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Managing Director – Brazil (Crypto Payment Business)
description:
Location: Brazil (must currently reside in Brazil with valid Brazilian ID)

Language: Fluent Portuguese (mandatory), strong English preferred


Overview:

We are seeking an experienced, crypto-savvy Managing Director to lead and expand our crypto payment business in Brazil. The ideal candidate must be Brazil-based, with prior experience in crypto, deep knowledge of the local crypto/payment ecosystem, and strong relationships with key regulatory and industry stakeholders. This role is critical to supporting Brazil licensing efforts, including assisting with the DASP licence, and will work closely with the Brazil AMLO on regulatory matters.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the company in obtaining the DASP licence, collaborating closely with AMLO Brazil on all regulatory submissions and compliance preparations.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with the Brazilian Central Bank (BCB) and the Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) to support licensing and ongoing regulatory engagement.
  • Expand business development opportunities through a strong local network across crypto, payments, fintech, and financial institutions.
  • Lead Brazil's business strategy and drive growth for all crypto-payment products.
  • Maintain excellent relationships with crypto industry associations such as ABCripto, ABCB, and other relevant bodies.
  • Represent the company as the senior business leader in Brazil, attending industry events, regulatory meetings, and partnership discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with global teams (product, compliance, legal, operations) to ensure commercial success and regulatory alignment.



Requirements:

  • Must currently reside in Brazil with a valid Brazilian ID.
  • Prior experience in crypto is a must.
  • 10+ years’ experience in crypto payments, payment institutions, fintech, or related financial services.
  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto/payment regulatory environment, including BCB and CVM frameworks.
  • Proven track record and strong personal network with BCB, CVM, and major industry associations (ABCripto, ABCB).
  • Demonstrated ability to support licensing processes for payment or crypto-related entities in Brazil.
  • Strong business development experience, with a proven ability to grow partnerships and drive commercial expansion.
  • Fluent Portuguese;
    strong English preferred.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and able to operate in a fast-paced environment.



Vision & Mission:

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Advogado Sr
description:
Advogado SR (ESG)

Sobre a Empresa

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos. Desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.


Sobre a Função

Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) na gestão das demandas de ESG da Arauco. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem o apoio em demandas ambientais, como licenciamento, defesas de autos de infração ambientais, pareceres técnicos, revisão de contratos da área, bem como a análise e mitigação de riscos ambientais, sociais e de governança.

O objetivo é garantir a conformidade legal, a segurança jurídica das operações nas melhores práticas de sustentabilidade dentro da companhia.


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar a gestão demandas ambientais;
  • Elaborar defesas em processos administrativos;
  • Redigir documentos destinados a órgãos públicos ambientais e sociais;
  • Prestar consultoria e assessoria jurídica, interpretando e aplicando leis e regulamentações relacionadas ao direito ambiental e administrativo, bem como fornecer orientação jurídica às áreas de negócios e operações sobre questões ambientais.
  • Mediar e resolver conflitos relacionados a propriedades utilizadas pela Arauco, buscando soluções extrajudiciais sempre que possível, representando a empresa em processos judiciais e administrativos relacionados a questões de responsabilidade social;
  • Acompanhar o cumprimento dos prazos e obrigações contratuais relacionados a área de ESG;

  • Apoio as atividades relacionadas ao licenciamento ambiental;
  • Cumprir e propagar a política de Meio Ambiente, qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional, bem como, a política de ética e Compliance, por todos os colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação e outros compromissos previstos, em todas as atividades produtos e serviços, incluindo os princípios e critérios das normas e ISOs;
